summary: Owner-bound resolution of the exact member-visibility surface and OMITTED AST state before canonical HIR; product checker NOT_RUN.
requires: the shared MemberVisibility surface is exactly +, -, or # on one of the 15 current MemberVisibility? owner productions
CST and AST preserve omission as OMITTED/null without a global default
the exact owner production and parent context resolve every omission before canonical HIR
new member slots default private while overrides and fulfillments inherit their selected slot or requirement
actor operations derive Actor or ActorProtocol effective transport visibility and have no independent handler visibility axis
member visibility is a static source and checker law and creates no runtime behavior
preconditions: the parser preserves the exact optional visibility token and the AST owner production
name and slot binding provide the exact parent context
override, Trait requirement, Actor, and ActorProtocol anchors are supplied exactly when their owner row requires them
normalization: preserve +, -, and # exactly and normalize them to PUBLIC, PRIVATE, and HIERARCHY_PROTECTED; preserve omission through AST as OMITTED/null, then apply exactly one owner row and seal a non-null effective HIR domain with provenance
decision_procedure: require the declaration owner to be one of the exact 15 grammar productions that directly admit MemberVisibility?
if a member callable uses common, private, protected, or public, reject with CALLABLE_VISIBILITY_KEYWORD_FORBIDDEN
require an owner-admitted parent context or reject with MEMBER_VISIBILITY_OMISSION_OWNER_CONTEXT_INVALID
preserve an explicit +, -, or # token, or retain an omitted token as OMITTED/null through AST
for a new member slot apply its exact private-default owner row; for an override or fulfillment require and inherit the selected original slot or requirement
for an actor operation derive Actor visibility or the Actor/ActorProtocol visibility meet without creating a handler-local visibility field
if a required anchor is missing reject with MEMBER_VISIBILITY_OMISSION_ANCHOR_MISSING instead of selecting a fallback
compare explicit override ranks in the exact lattice - < # < + and reject a rank below its original slot with OVERRIDE_VISIBILITY_CANNOT_NARROW
seal one non-null effective domain and provenance in typed HIR and return the admitted static MemberVisibilityFact
termination_metric: one of 15 owner rows, one finite parent-context match, and at most one slot, requirement, or actor/protocol visibility meet
evaluation_order: wrong visibility word -> owner/context admission -> required anchor -> owner-specific omission resolution -> explicit slot/requirement compatibility -> reference access
